release_notes: Release v1.1.26: Compressed the master index (Surahs, Juz, Quarters) to 3 columns with high-density cards for fast navigation; added click-away dismissal for the reader word card so tapping anywhere outside dismisses without selecting adjacent words; and introduced the word-by-word offline audio scraper tool (scripts/scrape_wbw_audio.py) with full documentation.
